name: Easy Artichoke Pasta
notes: First discovered by a pregnant and exhausted Eliza, who was happy to find a recipe that was one bowl, almost no prep, and delicious!

items: 1 × 12 oz can marinated artichoke hearts, juices included, chopped
1½ Tbsp chicken bullion (or chicken broth for the water, omitting bullion)

steps.title: Combine everything
steps.body: Combine in large pot or straight-sided skillet: **12 oz pasta**, **12 oz cooked chicken sausages**, sliced, **1 × 12 oz can marinated artichoke hearts**, juices included, chopped, **1 bunch spinach** (or sub frozen spinach), **4½–5 cups water**, **1½ Tbsp chicken bullion** (or substitute chicken broth for the water and omit bullion), **2 Tbsp olive oil** and **½ tsp black pepper**.

steps.title: Cook until saucy
steps.body: Put on high heat and stir constantly until pasta is cooked and liquid is almost gone (just a little bit saucy).

steps.title: Season and top
steps.body: Taste and add salt as needed. Top with parmesan cheese.
